kai (partnerships): FYI  Adele from GCP partner asked about a Manila (asia-southeast2) test listing for our hosted API. They want a sandbox entitlement for partner validation and an estimate of token throughput. Looking for approvals by end of week.

adele (gcp-partner): Hello! We can spin up a test listing in asia-southeast2. Need your MPN, a contact email, and the initial throughput target so our infra can size the sandbox.

tom (eng-infra): For hosted API sandboxing, we can provision 2 n1-standard + 1 A100 per test cluster. That supports roughly 40-60 req/s depending on model size. If they need more, give us projected tokens/s and concurrency.

sylvie (product): We should limit sandbox to non-sensitive data and rate-limit to prevent accidental customer data. Also need to ensure evals are disabled in the sandbox.

mike (sales): Is there an opportunity for a joint announcement? If onboarding goes well, partners often want a co-marketing blurb. We should align on messaging.

adele (gcp-partner): We'll coordinate marketing after validation. For now we need MPN RWD-1427 and contact marketplace-admin@redwood.ai. Also confirm whether you support per-customer private endpoints or just shared hosted endpoints in that region.

kai (partnerships): We support both, but private endpoints require Dedicated capacity; hosted shared endpoints are fine for sandbox. I'll send marketplace-admin and note that this is a sandbox.

compliance-bot: Reminder: Sandbox must not store PII. See internal policy link: https://redwood.internal/policies/sandbox-PII

tom (eng-infra): Example sizing note we will share with partner:
```
Cluster (sandbox):
- 2x n1-standard-16
- 1x A100 (40GB)
- Estimated throughput: 50 req/s (typical small model)
- Token budget: 2M tokens/day
```

;sylvie (product): Please add telemetry hooks for request sampling so we can compare perf to eu-west1.

mike (sales): I'll draft a short co-marketing outline once validation starts. Also, any regulatory approvals needed for PH region? Compliance team?

kai (partnerships): Good catch. Philippines doesn't have extra data residency requirements but we still need to ensure logging posture. Compliance, can you ack?

compliance-bot: Acknowledged. Ensure KMS residency is documented if customers ask.

adele (gcp-partner): I'll provision sandbox once we receive the email and MPN. I'll post the validation window and test credentials here.

tom (eng-infra): One more note: if they plan to run long-context models, memory will increase; we should ask partner for expected max sequence length.

kai (partnerships): Action items: (1) Kai -> send marketplace-admin + MPN to Adele, (2) Tom -> provide perf signals and telemetry hooks, (3) Sylvie -> ensure sandbox config blocks evals, (4) Mike -> draft marketing outline. Target: sandbox live by Friday.

adele (gcp-partner): Thanks. Will start provisioning after email.

kai (partnerships): Thanks team. We'll centralize details in partnership tracker and close the loop here. :white_check_mark:
